brand_identity.name: MotoDirect.nl
brand_identity.vibe: High-end automotive meets brutalist fintech trust. Aspirational yet grounded in strict financial reality.
brand_identity.concept: The Vault & The Open Road - Unlocking wholesale access for private buyers directly from the importer.

theme_strategy: Unified Architectural Dark Mode. Deep Obsidian background with Stark White text and Cobalt Blue accents to fuse automotive adrenaline with financial/GDPR trust.

headings.styling: Tracking-tight, radical weight contrast (font-black for massive impact). NEVER use Inter, Roboto, or Open Sans.

body.styling: Clean, stark, and data-heavy feel for motorcycle specs and BSN registration clarity.

colors.rules: No full-screen gradients. Use solid colors. Primary accent (#0047FF) is reserved STRICTLY for conversion CTAs (Reserveer nu) and trust verification badges.

layouts.spacing_system: Generous Spacing Philosophy. Use p-8, p-12, p-16. Containers with borders MUST have p-6 or p-8 internal padding to prevent collision.
layouts.catalog_grid: Mobile-first: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 with gap-8. Override default stretch with align-items: start.
layouts.detail_page_bento: Asymmetrical bento grid for motorcycle specs (cc, year, weight) beneath the main gallery. Mix col-span-2 and col-span-1.

component_styles.header_nav: Header MUST have a solid or glassmorphism background (backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#050505]/80). NEVER use a fully transparent header over hero images.
component_styles.hero_section: Immersive full-bleed image with bg-black/50 overlay. Text aligned to the left. Massive H1 (text-5xl to 6xl) highlighting 'Geen tussenpersoon'.
component_styles.motorcycle_card: Cardless/Flat design. Sharp corners (max rounded-sm). Image slightly scales up on hover. Tight data rows underneath with 1px borders separating cc, year, and dealer price. 'Dealerprijs' highlighted.
component_styles.filter_sidebar: Sticky positioning on desktop. High density (tight spacing). Use minimalist pill toggles instead of standard browser checkboxes.
component_styles.motor_detail: Wide hero gallery spanning 2/3 of the layout. The remaining 1/3 is a sticky pricing/reservation widget emphasizing the 35% deposit via Stripe.
component_styles.checkout_stepper: Fintech clarity. Stark white surface cards inside the dark mode to emphasize the BSN and Stripe secure payment area, establishing absolute trust.
component_styles.weekly_arrival_widget: Small, dense banner featuring a glowing green pulse animation (animate-pulse) next to 'Verwachte aankomst: Wekelijks'.

motion.scroll: Use Lenis for smooth momentum scrolling.
motion.interactions: Hover states on all interactive elements. Buttons must have a slight translate-y-1 and shadow-lg on hover.
motion.page_transitions: Fade up elements on scroll (using framer-motion).

accessibility.contrast: Ensure APCA standards. White text on Deep Obsidian background is extremely high contrast.
accessibility.data_testid: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case, based on role (e.g., data-testid='reserve-motor-button', data-testid='bsn-input').

instructions_to_main_agent: Implement a completely dark-themed application using #050505 as the main background.
Use pure HTML and Tailwind for marketing/hero sections, reserving Shadcn strictly for interactive forms (checkout, filters, login).
Do NOT center-align the main application container. Left-align dense text like specs.
Create a custom layout for the motorcycle detail page with a sticky right sidebar for the 'Reserveer nu' checkout widget.
Ensure all interactive elements have data-testid attributes.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur) where necessary. NEVER use a fully transparent header over hero images.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g., transition: all).
You MUST NOT center align the app container, i.e., do not add .App { text-align: center; } in the css file.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp buttons with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
Use sonner for toasts. Sonner component is located in /app/src/components/ui/sonner.tsx.
